summary: A 50-year-old man from Texas was fatally injured in a snowmobile accident about 2.5 miles up Quartz Creek; reported at 3:04 p.m. via the Alamosa Regional Communication Center, he succumbed to his injuries while friends and family were transporting him out of the backcountry.
location: Quartz Creek, ~2.5 miles up the drainage (Creede area)
notes: Sourced from the Pagosa Springs SUN's '2024 year in review' retrospective (Jan 2, 2025 issue); MCSO issued the statement. Friends/family were transporting him out when he succumbed.
